before.title: MIMIC — minimally invasive metastasectomy for osteosarcoma lung metastases
before.why: Ethos Discovery's current MIMIC page explicitly says the trial is open and currently enrolling dogs with osteosarcoma that has spread or is suspected to have spread to the lungs.
before.intervention: Thoracoscopic minimally invasive surgical removal of pulmonary metastatic nodules
before.funding: 🟡 Partially funded. Study procedures are subsidized and provided at reduced cost; confirm the current owner contribution with the enrolling hospital.
before.contact: Ethos Discovery enrollment request through official MIMIC study page
before.notes: Dog >5 kg; OSA primary tumor must be controlled or controllable with surgery or radiation; suspected or confirmed pulmonary metastasis. This is a treatment study for metastatic OSA, not merely surveillance.
before.special_requirement: Suspected or confirmed lung metastases from osteosarcoma; primary tumor controlled or controllable by surgery/radiation. The team confirms pulmonary disease and the current owner contribution.
